body: A Kanal is always 20 Marla. What changes is the size of a Marla: most new societies use 225 sq ft, so 5 Marla is about 1,125 sq ft, while older records and some areas use 272.25 sq ft.
Compare plots in square feet or square yards. Capital Smart City, for example, lists a 10 Marla plot as 250 sq yd (2,250 sq ft).
On this page, hover over a plot size to see its approximate square footage.
marlaKanal.excerpt: 1 Kanal = 20 Marla. A Marla is usually 225 sq ft, but some areas use 272.25 sq ft, so check the society's own measure.
marlaKanal.title: Marla vs Kanal explained

body: A legal housing society needs approval from a development authority: CDA in Islamabad, RDA in Rawalpindi, LDA in Lahore, or the district body elsewhere.
Ask which authority approved the layout plan and for the NOC reference, then find the society on that authority's list of approved schemes. A layout plan (LOP) approval is not the same as a full NOC.
If a society says its NOC is "in process", treat it as higher risk and keep payments to the booking amount until the approval is issued.
noc.excerpt: Find the approving authority (CDA, RDA, LDA or the district body) and check the society on its approved list before you pay anything.
noc.title: How to check a society's NOC

body: Most developers ask for a copy of your CNIC or NICOP, your next of kin's CNIC and passport-size photos with the application form.
The down payment is usually paid by bank transfer or pay order in the developer's name, never to an individual. Keep the receipt; the file is issued against it.
Get every instalment date in writing and set reminders in Pakistan time. Late instalments can lead to surcharges or cancellation.
overseas.excerpt: Documents most developers ask for: CNIC or NICOP, passport-size photos and your next of kin's CNIC, plus how to pay from abroad.
overseas.title: Overseas Pakistani buying checklist
